title: Valar Atomics button
description: A square-cornered mono caps button, 48px tall: either a see-through dark box with a 1px gold frame or a solid ink box. On hover it floods with gold and the text turns black (0.15s).
notes: the frame variant is made for dark bands (put it inside a `dark` scope on a light page)
name: valaratomics-button

props.name: label
props.description: the button text (shown uppercase in the mono face)

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it a <button> is rendered

props.name: variant
props.description: frame: a see-through dark box with a 1px gold frame · solid: a filled ink box (e.g. SHOW MORE)
